reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that embeds the DOOM shareware game as a draggable browser window with keyboard controls, audio, bundled assets, and a /doom toggle command.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可拖动的 DOOM 共享版游戏窗口，支持键盘操作、音效和关卡音乐。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable DOOM shareware game window to the DeepSeek Harness web UI with keyboard controls, sound effects, and level music.

capabilities: Embeds and runs a DOOM game engine compiled to WebAssembly in the browser
Provides a draggable game window with keyboard controls and WebAudio sound
Registers a /doom command and exposes an HTTP endpoint for synchronizing window state
Serves bundled game assets and downloads additional engine assets on first use
